nodes.label: Room-scale Crouch (#27)
nodes.rationale: Syncs physical crouch to game crouch state while compensating camera height to prevent double-drop.

nodes.label: Physical Melee Parry (#26)
nodes.rationale: Vetoes incoming melee hits by checking proximity between VR weapon blade and enemy weapon segments.

nodes.label: SS2VRMeleeTipCollision
nodes.rationale: Squirrel script responsible for physical-contact melee detection using vhot2 (grip) to vhot4 (tip) + reach.

nodes.label: SS2VRMeleeComputeDamage
nodes.rationale: Read-layer function that calculates damage based on base, targetType, research, strength, osUpgrade, weaponMod, and charge.

nodes.label: sq_scripts/ss2vr_melee_scaling.nut
nodes.rationale: Isolated module for melee damage scaling logic to prevent parse errors from killing the main probe.

nodes.label: ss2vr_interact.nut
nodes.rationale: Chokepoint for interaction logic, including player self-bracket filtering and aggro/attacked visibility latching.

nodes.label: SS2VRAmpCableUpdate
nodes.rationale: Spring driving logic for the psi-amp cable joint, later mitigated due to engine crashes.

nodes.label: DLL v2.81
nodes.rationale: Introduced native-look health bars using EE HPBAR assets.

nodes.label: DLL v2.82
nodes.rationale: Implements native 2D bracket suppression by gating DPCHUDDrawRect.

nodes.label: FunkMaxExport
nodes.rationale: 3ds Max tool for LGMD/LGPMNM export, handling vhots, material aux records, and vertex compaction.
